NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 27, 4:33 PM ET

The Rams are the top-projected defense on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 7.4 DraftKings points for $3,500, against the Chargers. Steelers (7.3, $3,300) and Bengals (7.2, $3,800) are next.

The Steelers return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.21 projected points per $1,000 at $3,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 27, 4:33 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 8

Rams, LAR vs LAC ($3,500)

Rams carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.4 DraftKings points at $3,500. That is 0.1 points clear of Steelers. The salary works out to 2.13 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 5 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Rams averaged 7.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 16.3, and it holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.

Value: Steelers, PIT vs CLE ($3,300)

Steelers projects for 7.3 DraftKings points at $3,300, which works out to 2.21 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 5 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Steelers averaged 7.4 points with a simulated floor of -0.3 and a ceiling of 15.7, and it holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Pittsburgh is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Cleveland, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 39.5.
